answer: Agents deliver 800MB of verified bandwidth daily to a secure lagoon registry to prove presence. Each honest identity pays 1x cost for data transfer, while 1,000 fakes must transmit 800GB of non-colluding, signed payloads. A comet sensor scans for packet replay; if a hash collision appears, a saffron-encoded audit slashes the node. An identity stays active for 30 days unless an audit reveals pooled bytes, triggering an immediate burn of the identity stake.
